result.topic_en: Riemann considers a function of n variables whose second-order change along lines through a point is a homogeneous quadratic form in the differentials, $ds^2=\sum a_{i,k}dx_i dx_k$ with point-dependent coefficients, and then sets up the variational condition $\delta\int\sqrt{\Omega}=0$ for shortest lines, deriving their differential equations.
